options_provider_hint: Add one or more providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Cloudflare, or the key-free "Manual" mode) and pick one per meeting. The API key is stored only on this device.
options_template_hint: You can change the template per meeting; this is only the initial default.
options_hide_captions_label: Hide the captions panel on the Meet page
options_hide_captions_hint: Off by default. When on, the captions box on the Google Meet page is freed up during recording; the extension's recording and transcription continue unchanged since they read from the same DOM element (even hidden). Note: the live caption language must still be set inside Google Meet itself (Settings > Captions).
options_include_transcript_label: Include the full transcript in TXT, Markdown, Word, and PDF exports
options_include_transcript_hint: Off by default — meaning these four export formats only include the summary, decisions, actions, and advanced analysis, not the full transcript.
options_about_text: AI Meet — records, transcribes, and intelligently summarizes Google Meet meetings with full Persian support.
options_language_hint: Changes the language of every page in this extension (settings and side panel); independent of your browser's language.
provider_type_openai_compatible: OpenAI or a compatible server (Ollama, etc.)
provider_manual_note: This provider needs no API key. When generating a report, the extension gives you ready-to-copy text to paste into any AI chat (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.) and bring the reply back.
provider_cloudflare_note: This path uses Cloudflare's new unified endpoint (/ai/run): no separate Gemini API key is needed — just a Cloudflare API Token with Account > Workers AI > Read access.
template_new_instruction: Write your own system instruction here; the output must still follow the same JSON contract.
sync_github_baseurl: Base URL (only for a self-hosted GitLab/Azure DevOps — leave empty for the public SaaS)
sync_github_hint: The token needs Contents: Read and write on the target repository (a fine-grained PAT is recommended).
sync_gitlab_baseurl: GitLab instance URL (empty = gitlab.com; set this for a self-hosted instance)
sync_gitlab_token: Personal/Project Access Token (with api or write_repository scope)
sync_gitlab_repo: Project path (e.g. group/project, or just project if owner is also filled)
sync_gitlab_hint: If you run a self-hosted GitLab, put its full URL in "Base URL"; leave it empty for gitlab.com.
sync_azure_baseurl: Collection URL for a self-hosted server/TFS (empty = cloud dev.azure.com)
sync_azure_owner: Organization name (only if Base URL is empty)
sync_azure_hint: For an on-prem Azure DevOps Server, put the Collection URL in "Base URL" (e.g. https://tfs.mycompany.com/tfs/DefaultCollection). The "Project" field is also required for Azure DevOps.
sidepanel_empty_state: No meeting recorded yet. Join a Google Meet call to start automatic recording.
sidepanel_manual_modal_hint: 1) Copy the text below. 2) Paste it into any AI chat (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, ...) and run it. 3) Paste its full reply (must be JSON) into the box below and click "Process".
sidepanel_manual_parse_error: Could not parse the reply as JSON. Please check it and try again.
sidepanel_no_analysis: No AI analysis has been generated for this meeting yet.
